description: The top-down market regime read: risk-on, be-selective or stand-down. Returns the regime verdict, mode and permission ladder (index → sector → name) for each book (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, macro, BTC/ETH crypto). Each book's regime carries `posture` (headline, tone, tape_posture and a note fusing the daily read, the intraday tape and the engine's management posture). Free; data is one market day delayed.
name: get_market_regime
